info.title: Wex Health and Benefits APIs
info.description: All external APIs merged for documentation and discovery

get.description: Download a CSV report for mass updates based on specified criteria including client ID, user IDs, and batch job type

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: API version

parameters.name: ClientId
parameters.description: Client identifier for the organization

parameters.name: UserIds
parameters.description: Comma or space-separated list of user IDs (numbers only)

parameters.name: BatchJobType
parameters.description: Type of batch job for report generation

200.description: Report generated successfully - returns CSV file

400.description: Invalid request parameters or user authentication

404.description: No data found for the specified criteria

500.description: Internal server error during report generation

post.description: Upload a CSV file for batch processing of mass updates. Maximum file size: 50MB. Only CSV files are supported.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: API version

requestBody.description: Upload request containing the CSV file, client ID, and batch job type

200.description: File uploaded and processing initiated successfully

400.description: Invalid file format, size, or request parameters

415.description: Unsupported file type (only CSV files are allowed)

500.description: Internal server error during file processing

get.description: Retrieve detailed information about a claim and related information by Person ID and Claim Number

parameters.name: person_id
parameters.description: The GUID generated by the Identity Management System for accessing information belonging to this specific person.

parameters.name: claim_number
parameters.description: The Claim number, an alphanumeric string, e.g. 11BPEB1210513P0000101

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: Optional correlation ID associated with the request, comprised of alphanumeric or hyphen characters up to 36 characters in length.

404.description: Not Found.  No Consumer found for supplied ID.

parameters.name: page_size

parameters.name: index

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: Optional correlation ID associated with the request, comprised of alphanumeric or hyphen characters up to 36 characters in length.

get.description: Retrieve a list of receipt entities belonging to a specific person by Person ID, filtered by receipt type, receipt type identifier, and number of months back, paginated

parameters.name: person_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the person whose receipts are being retrieved

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of items to return per page

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Page index (zero-based)

parameters.name: receipt_type_identifier
parameters.description: Identifier to filter receipts by specific type

parameters.name: receipt_type
parameters.description: Type of receipt to filter by (ALL, CLAIM, or EXPENSE)

parameters.name: number_of_months_back
parameters.description: Number of months to look back for receipts from current date

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: Optional correlation ID associated with the request, comprised of alphanumeric or hyphen characters up to 36 characters in length.

404.description: Not Found.  No Consumer found for supplied ID.

claim_number.description: A unique identifier assigned to the claim.

claim_amount.description: The total amount of the claim submitted.

submission_date.description: The date the claim was submitted.

start_date_of_service.description: The first date services were provided for the claim.

end_date_of_service.description: The last date services were provided for the claim.

processed_date.description: The date the claim was processed.

provider_name.description: The name of the provider associated with the claim.

paid_amount.description: The amount reimbursed for the claim.

submitted_amount.description: The original amount submitted for reimbursement.

is_ptp.description: Indicates whether the claim is part of a pay-the-provider process.

denial_reasons.description: The reason(s) the submitted claim was denied, if applicable.

requests_for_more_information.description: Request(s) for additional information for the submitted claim, if applicable.

denied_amount.description: The total amount of the claim that was denied.

applied_deductible_amount.description: The portion of the claim amount applied to a deductible.

claim_source.description: The source of the claim submission.

scheduled_for_reimbursement_date.description: The date the claim is scheduled for reimbursement.
